title: pinn-review: reproducible pipeline for a bibliometric mapping, evidence audit and equal-budget re-evaluation of physics-informed neural networks and neural operators
description: Code, protocol, processed data, coding records, benchmark runs, figures and tables behind the review article. Every number in the article is generated from these files.
